name: Darren Arbet
bio: Darren Arbet was the head coach for the Bay Area Pathers in 2023. He would leave Bay Area with 10 games remaining in the season. He coached 5 games for a 3-2 record.

name: Billy Back
bio: Billy Back has been coaching indoor football since 2013 with the Texas Revolution. He's coached for Texas, Wichita Falls, Spokane, Frisco, and currently Tucson. Back would have the most success with Frisco, taking them to a 27-6 record between 2022 and 2023. They would win in the first round of both year's playoffs, but would lose in the following games. Back currently coaches for Tucson, returning for his 2nd season with them. He has a combined record of 63-46.

name: Chad Baldwin
bio: Chad Baldwin coached the Green Bay Blizzard during the 2013 and 2014 seasons. In 2013 he took over midseason and finished 3-5. In 2014 he coached 6 games, all losses, and was fired. He combined for a record of 3-11.

name: Danton Barto
bio: Danton Barto coached the Arkansas Diamonds in 2010. He led them to 1st place in the Lonestar East and would make it to the confrence championship. They would lose 53-42 againist the Billings Outlaws. That season Arkansas would go 11-3 in the regular seaosn and 2-1 in the post season. Barto would finish coaching with a 13-4 record.

name: David Beezer
bio: David Beezer coached the San Diego Strike Force in 2022. They would go 3-13 and miss the playoffs. Beezer was not resigned for the following season and hasn't coached in the IFL since.

name: Rodney Blackshear
bio: Rodney Blackshear coached the Abilene Ruff Riders from 2009-2010, and the Amarillo Venom in 2011. In 2009 he came into Abiliene midseason and took the 0-5 team to the playoffs with an 8-1 record under him. Unfortunately they'd lose to the San Angelo Stampede Express 37-34. Blackshear retruned for the 2010 season but didn't find the same success, taking the team to a 2-12 record. He would take a job with the Amarillo Venom in 2011 and finished 4-10. His combined coaching record sits at 14-24.

name: Dominic Bramante
bio: Dominic Bramante was the head coach for the Northern Arizona Wranglers. He would start with the Duke City Gladiators from 2015-2019, winning Coach of the Year in 2018 and leading them to 2 championships. He then would transition to the IFL joining NAZ for their 2021 season. He would coach 7 out of 10 games for them with a 1-6 record, missing 3 due to COVID protocols. He was dismissed with 4 games remaining. He was brought back to Duke CIty as an co-head coach. His IFL record sits at 1-6.

name: Joe Brannen
bio: Joe Brannen coached for the Iowa Barnstormers from 2015-2016. In 2015 he led Iowa to a 6-8 record and was resigned for the following season. 2016 he took Iowa to a 4-12 record and was not resigned. His record sits at 10-20.

name: Brian Brents
bio: Brian Brents coached the El Paos Generals during their first and only season in 2009. He finished the season 12-2, top of the Lone Star divison, and earning them a first round bye. He then won their first playoff game againist the San Angelo Stampede Express. blowing them out 75-37. They would go on to lose againist the Billings Outlaws, 66-35. Billings would go onto win the championship. El Paso would end up folding and Brents did not resume coaching in the IFL. His record sits at 13-3.

name: Richard Britt
bio: Richard Britt was the head coach of the Lehigh Valley Steelhawks during the 2011 season. He led the team to a 4-10 record and was fired after the 2011 season.

name: Landrick Brody
bio: Landrick Brody was the OC of the Northern Arizona Wranglers. He took over as interim head coach for 7 games during the 2021 season, due to HC Dominic Bramante missing 3 games due to COVID, and who was fired with 4 games remaining. Brody lost all 7 of those games and was let go after the 2021 season. Brody also played for the Duke City Gladiators, and coached for them during their 2018 and 2019 championships before joining the IFL.

name: Gilbert Brown
bio: Gilbert Brown, former Green Bay Packer, coached for the La Crosse Spartans during the 2010 and 2011 seasons. In his debut season, Brown led the team to a 3-11 record. He returned for the 2011 season, starting 2-2. After those 4 games, Breown announced that he would take a leave of absence. He never returned. He would go on to Coach indoor football again, coaching for the Lingerie Football League for the Green Bay Chili from 2011 to 2014

name: Pig Brown
bio: Pig Brown, star LB for the Nebraska Danger, turned to coach after his 6-year run in the IFL. He took over as Coach to the Danger in 2019. Brown led Nebraska to a 7-7 record and a win against the Blizzard in the first round of playoffs. After 2019 he decided to take his talents to Duke City for the 2020 season. Unfortunately due to COVID, he didn't get the chance. Brown would not return for the 2021 season and has not returned to coaching.

name: Kurt Bryan
bio: Kurt Bryan was named the first head coach of the then-Oakland Pathers in 2019. After the COVID pandemic, he got his shot for the 2022 season. Bryan coached the Bay Area Panthers to a 1-15 record. He did not return for the 2023 season.

name: Quinn Cairo
bio: Quinn Cairo was the interim head coach of the Allen Wranglers in 2012. He would go 4-2, but would not take up a head coaching job anywhere else.

name: Kenton Carr
bio: Kenton Carr was the head coach for the Bloomington Extreme/Edge. He was the head coach for the Extreme from 2008-2010 and returned in 2012. After taking the 2008 Edge to the championship game, his 2009 season was less successful. Finishing 10-4, the Edge lost in the first round of playoffs. Carr would come back for the 2010 season but be fired after a 3-5 start. Carr would be hired back in 2012, where he would take the Extreme to another 10-4 season with another first-round playoff loss. Carr would part ways with the team after the 2012 season.

name: Sherman Carter
bio: Sherman Carter was the head coach of the Duke City Gladiators in 2022. He would go 8-8 but step down due to time restraints in another job.

name: Mike Davis
bio: Mike Davis is the current head coach of the Vegas Knight Hawks. After a 6 year run with the Nebraska Danger, he took a break til 2022 when he joined Vegas. He has coached over 140 games in the IFL, with 9 of those in the playoffs. No championships to his name but had one of his best seasons in 2024 taking Vegas to a 11-5 record.

name: Taylor Genuser
bio: Taylor Genuser has been the head coach for the San Diego Strike Force since 2023. With a combined 16-15 record along with a playoff appearance he goes into his 3rd year after his best season in 2024.

name: Jason Gibson
bio: Jason Gibson is the head coach of the Jacksonville Sharks. After taking the Sharks to a championship in the NAL, he started his IFL career going 5-11. Gibson has been coaching indoor football for 23 years, in multiple leagues. His longest run was with the Columbus Lions going 131-73. After 5years with the Lions in the NAL, he took his talents to Jacksonville in 2023, winning a championship. Now he sets his sights on a 2nd year in the IFL.

name: Kevin Guy
bio: Kevin Guy is the current head coach of the Arizona Rattlers since 2008, leading the team to multiple championships in the Arena Football League (AFL) and Indoor Football League (IFL). Guy also has the most wins in IFL and indoor football history. Guy is also a co-owner of the Tucson Sugar Skulls, contributing to the growth of indoor football in Arizona.

name: Ron James
bio: Ron James is the head coach of the Northern Arizona Wranglers. James is a seasoned American football coach with a career spanning multiple leagues, including the Arena Football League (AFL) and now moves to the Indoor Football League (IFL). Known for his leadership and strategic expertise, James has served as head coach for several teams, including the Utah Blaze, Pittsburgh Power, and Tampa Bay Storm. With a commitment to excellence, James hopes to show off his talents for Northern Arizona.

name: Marvin Jones
bio: Marvin Jones is the head coach for the Tulsa Oilers. He started in 2017 with the Colorado Crush taking over mid-season and going 1-7. He then moved to the Cedar Rapids Titans in 2018. They went 3-11 and missed playoffs. After a 5 year break, he rejoined the league for the Tulsa Oilers. His first season was a trainwreck, going 2-13. Jones would return for 2024 and they would improve to a 6-10 record. Now Jones leads the team for a 3rd straight year, hoping to improve even more.

name: Rob Keefe
bio: Rob Keefe is the current head coach for the Bay Area Panthers. He took over midseason in 2023 taking the team 7-3 and 3 playoff wins including winning the championship. Keefe would return in 2024 and led them to a 13-3 record, best in the West. They would lose the first round of playoffs. He now returns for his 3rd year for Bay Area. Keefe previously played in multiple indoor leagues, winning ArenaBowl championships with the Spokane Shock and Philadelphia Soul. Transitioning to coaching, he quickly made his mark, guiding the Spokane Shock to an ArenaBowl title in his first season as head coach in 2010. Keefe has also coached other prominent teams, including the Albany Empire, leading them to back-to-back ArenaBowl championships in 2019 and 2021.
